title: Staying on the Attack Path: Structured State for Long-Horizon Automated Penetration Testing
abstract: arXiv:2609.07344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) based agents are increasingly applied to cybersecurity tasks such as vulnerability discovery and automated penetration testing. On long-horizon security tasks, however, such agents remain limited by context forgetting and intent drift: early critical facts and causal reasoning chains are lost over extended interactions, and the agent falls into aimless, repetitive exploration. This paper proposes Intentest, an intent-graph-guided automated penetration testing agent that externalizes long-horizon state from the LLM's context window onto a persistent fact-intent directed acyclic graph (DAG), thereby substantially reducing invalid transitions. We evaluate Intentest on automated penetration testing of web applications, a representative long-tail task in cybersecurity. translated_title: 坚守攻击路径：面向长时程自动化渗透测试的结构化状态
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体正越来越多地应用于漏洞发现和自动化渗透测试等网络安全任务。然而，在长时程安全任务中，此类智能体仍受限于上下文遗忘和意图漂移：早期关键事实和因果推理链在长期交互中逐渐丢失，导致智能体陷入漫无目的的重复探索。本文提出了Intentest，一种由意图图引导的自动化渗透测试智能体，它将长时程状态从LLM的上下文窗口外化到持久的事实-意图有向无环图（DAG）上，从而显著减少无效转换。研究者在网络应用程序的自动化渗透测试这一具有代表性的网络安全长尾任务上对Intentest进行了评估。在该DAG中，经验证的网络状态被存储为不可变的事实节点，探索方向则被约束为受先验条件限制的意图边。
tldr: 本文提出Intentest智能体，通过将长时程状态外化到持久的事实-意图有向无环图（DAG）上，解决了LLM智能体在自动化渗透测试中的上下文遗忘和意图漂移问题，显著减少了无效探索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Intentest, an intent-graph-guided automated penetration testing agent that externalizes long-horizon state onto a persistent fact-intent DAG, addressing context forgetting and intent drift in LLM-based agents while substantially reducing invalid exploration.
